blocks.text: "Bryce Harper was playing T-ball at age three against six-year-olds,... He has played between 80 and 130 baseball games a year each year for the past seven years...

Bryce Harper is the product of a travel baseball industry that mushroomed, just as he himself was growing up, into big business. There seems no end to the tournaments, all-star games, showcases, wood-bat leagues, USA Baseball youth teams, "scout teams" sponsored by major league clubs."
